name: Fascia (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fascia (quartered maroon and white with wheat sheaves) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Fascia, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Fascia arms — quartered maroon and white with wheat sheaves, crowned, within branches
